info.name: Blog REST API
info.description:
# Blog REST API

A REST API for a Blog Management Application.

## Access Levels

- Guest
    
- User
    
- Admin
    

## Features

- User registration and login
    
- Token-based authentication
    
- Role-based authorization
    
- User profile management
    
- Password update
    
- Admin user management
    
- Blog creation
    
- Blog update and deletion
    
- Public blog viewing
    
- Blog search by title
    
- Blog filtering by category
    

## Base URL

[http://localhost:5000](http://localhost:5000)

## Authentication

Protected endpoints require a Bearer Token.

Authorization header:

Bearer

## Main API Groups

### Authentication

- Register
    
- Login
    

### User Management

- Get all users
    
- Get user by ID
    
- Activate/Deactivate user
    
- Get own profile
    
- Update own profile
    
- Update password
    

### Blog Management

- Create blog
    
- Get all blogs
    
- Get blog by ID
    
- Search blogs
    
- Filter blogs
    
- Update blog
    
- Delete blog

## Register User

Creates a new user account.

### Method

POST

### Endpoint

/api/auth/register

### Access

Public

### Request Body

{  
"firstname": "John",  
"lastname": "Doe",  
"email": "[john@example.com](https://mailto:john@example.com)",  
"password": "password123"  
}

### Validation

- Required fields cannot be empty.
    
- Email must have a valid format.
    
- Email must be unique.
    
- Password must meet the minimum length requirement.
    
- New users are created with the default role: user.
    
- New users are active by default.
    
- Users cannot assign themselves the admin role.
    

### Success

201 Created

## User Login

Authenticates a registered user and returns an authentication token.

### Method

POST

### Endpoint

/api/auth/login

### Access

Public

### Request Body

{  
"email": "[john@example.com](https://mailto:john@example.com)",  
"password": "password123"  
}

### Requirements

- Email and password are required.
    
- User must exist.
    
- User must be active.
    
- Credentials must be valid.
    

### Success

200 OK

Returns an authentication token.

### Errors

401 Unauthorized - Invalid credentials or deactivated account.

## Admin Login

Authenticates an active admin user and returns an authentication token.

### Method

POST

### Endpoint

/api/auth/login

### Access

Public

### Request Body

{  
"email": "[admin@example.com](https://mailto:admin@example.com)",  
"password": "password123"  
}

### Requirements

- Email and password are required.
    
- Admin user must exist.
    
- Admin account must be active.
    
- Credentials must be valid.
    
- User must have the admin role.
    

### Success

200 OK

Returns an authentication token for the admin user.

### Errors

401 Unauthorized - Invalid credentials or deactivated account.

## Get All Users

Retrieves all registered users.

### Method

GET

### Endpoint

/api/users

### Access

Admin Only

### Requirements

- Authentication is required.
    
- Only an admin can access this endpoint.
    
- All registered users are returned.
    
- Passwords must never be exposed.
    

### Success

200 OK

Returns a list of users without passwords.

### Errors

401 Unauthorized - Authentication token is missing or invalid.  
403 Forbidden - User does not have admin permission.

## Get User by ID

Retrieves a specific user by their ID.

### Method

GET

### Endpoint

/api/users/:id

### Access

Admin Only

### Requirements

- Authentication is required.
    
- Only an admin can access this endpoint.
    
- The user ID must exist.
    
- Password must not be returned.
    

### Success

200 OK

Returns the requested user's information.

### Errors

401 Unauthorized - Authentication token is missing or invalid.  
403 Forbidden - User does not have admin permission.  
404 Not Found - User does not exist.

## Get All Users - Normal User Authorization Test

Verifies that a normal user cannot access the admin-only users list.

### Method

GET

### Endpoint

/api/users

### Access

Normal User - Forbidden

### Requirements

- Authentication is required.
    
- A normal user must not be allowed to access all users.
    
- Only admins can access this endpoint.
    

### Expected Result

403 Forbidden

### Expected Response

{  
"message": "Access denied. You do not have permission."  
}

## Get Own Profile

Returns the profile information of the currently authenticated user.

### Method

GET

### Endpoint

/api/users/profile

### Access

User/Admin

### Authorization

Bearer Token

### Requirements

- Authentication is required.
    
- The profile belongs to the currently logged-in user.
    
- Password must never be returned.
    

### Success

200 OK

Returns the authenticated user's profile information.

### Errors

401 Unauthorized - Authentication token is missing or invalid.  
404 Not Found - User does not exist.

## Update Own Profile

Updates the profile information of the currently authenticated user.

### Method

PUT

### Endpoint

/api/users/profile/update

### Access

User/Admin

### Authorization

Bearer Token

### Request Body

{  
"firstname": "John",  
"lastname": "Smith"  
}

### Requirements

- Authentication is required.
    
- User can update their own profile only.
    
- First name and last name must not be empty.
    
- User must not be allowed to modify the role.
    
- User must not be allowed to modify isActive.
    

### Success

200 OK

Returns a success message after updating the profile.

### Errors

400 Bad Request - Required fields are missing or invalid.  
401 Unauthorized - Authentication token is missing or invalid.  
404 Not Found - User does not exist.

## Update Password

Updates the password of the currently authenticated user.

### Method

PATCH

### Endpoint

/api/users/password

### Access

User/Admin

### Authorization

Bearer Token

### Request Body

{  
"password": "newPassword123"  
}

### Requirements

- Authentication is required.
    
- New password is required.
    
- Password must satisfy the minimum length requirement.
    
- Password must be hashed before storing.
    
- Plain-text password must never be stored in the database.
    

### Success

200 OK

Returns a success message after successfully updating the password.

### Errors

400 Bad Request - Password is missing or invalid.  
401 Unauthorized - Authentication token is missing or invalid.  
404 Not Found - User does not exist.

## Deactivate User

Deactivates a registered user account.

### Method

PATCH

### Endpoint

/api/users/:id/status

### Access

Admin Only

### Request Body

{  
"isActive": false  
}

### Requirements

- Authentication is required.
    
- Only an admin can deactivate users.
    
- isActive must be a boolean value.
    
- The target user must exist.
    

### Success

200 OK

{  
"message": "User deactivated successfully."  
}

### Errors

400 Bad Request - isActive must be true or false.  
401 Unauthorized - Authentication token is missing or invalid.  
403 Forbidden - User does not have admin permission.  
404 Not Found - User does not exist.

## Deactivated User Login Test

Verifies that a deactivated user cannot log in.

### Method

POST

### Endpoint

/api/auth/login

### Access

Public

### Request Body

{  
"email": "[john@example.com](https://mailto:john@example.com)",  
"password": "password123"  
}

### Requirement

- The user account must be deactivated before this test.
    
- A deactivated user must not be able to log in.
    

### Expected Result

401 Unauthorized

### Expected Response

{  
"message": "Your account is deactivated."  
}

## Activate User

Reactivates a previously deactivated user account.

### Method

PATCH

### Endpoint

/api/users/:id/status

### Access

Admin Only

### Request Body

{  
"isActive": true  
}

### Requirements

- Authentication is required.
    
- Only an admin can activate users.
    
- isActive must be a boolean value.
    
- The target user must exist.
    

### Success

200 OK

{  
"message": "User activated successfully."  
}

### Errors

400 Bad Request - isActive must be true or false.  
401 Unauthorized - Authentication token is missing or invalid.  
403 Forbidden - User does not have admin permission.  
404 Not Found - User does not exist.

## Create Blog

Creates a new blog for the authenticated user.

### Method

POST

### Endpoint

/api/blogs/create

### Access

User / Admin

### Authorization

Bearer Token

### Request Body

{  
"blogTitle": "Introduction to API Testing",  
"blog": "This article explains the fundamentals of API testing.",  
"category": "Testing"  
}

### Requirements

- Authentication is required.
    
- blogTitle, blog and category are required.
    
- The userId must be taken from the authenticated user.
    
- The client must not provide userId manually.
    
- Blog title cannot be empty.
    
- Blog content cannot be empty.
    

### Success

201 Created

Returns a success message and the newly created blog ID.

### Example Response

{  
"message": "Blog created successfully.",  
"blogId": 15  
}

### Errors

400 Bad Request - Required fields are missing or empty.  
401 Unauthorized - Authentication token is missing or invalid.  
500 Internal Server Error - Server or database error.

## All Blogs

Retrieves all publicly available blogs with basic author information.

### Method

GET

### Endpoint

/api/blogs

### Access

Public

### Authentication

Not required.

### Request

No request body is required.

### Response

Returns a list of blogs containing:

- Blog ID
    
- Blog title
    
- Blog content
    
- Category
    
- Creation time
    
- Update time
    
- Author ID
    
- Author first name
    
- Author last name
    

### Security

- Passwords must never be exposed.
    
- Sensitive user information must not be returned.
    

### Success

200 OK

Returns the list of blogs with author information.

### Error

500 Internal Server Error - Internal server/database error.

## Blog Update Owner

Updates a blog owned by the authenticated user.

### Method

PUT

### Endpoint

/api/blogs/update/:id

### Access

Authenticated User/Admin

### Request Body

{  
"blogTitle": "Updated Blog Title",  
"blog": "Updated blog content",  
"category": "Automation"  
}

### Requirements

- Authentication is required.
    
- The blog must exist.
    
- A normal user can update only their own blog.
    
- Required fields cannot be empty.
    
- The blog title cannot be empty.
    
- The blog content cannot be empty.
    
- The category cannot be empty.
    
- Admin users can update any user's blog.
    

### Success

200 OK

Returns a successful blog update message.

### Errors

400 Bad Request - Required fields are missing or empty.  
401 Unauthorized - Authentication token is missing or invalid.  
403 Forbidden - User is not the owner of the blog.  
404 Not Found - Blog does not exist.  
500 Internal Server Error - Server or database error.

item.name: User Cannot Update Another User's Blog

request.description:
## Blog Update Normal User

Tests authorization by attempting to update another user's blog using a normal user account.

### Method

PUT

### Endpoint

/api/blogs/update/:id

### Access

Authenticated Normal User

### Request Body

{  
"blogTitle": "Unauthorized Update",  
"blog": "Trying to update another user's blog.",  
"category": "Testing"  
}

### Requirements

- Authentication is required.
    
- The normal user must be logged in.
    
- The requested blog must belong to another user.
    
- A normal user must not be allowed to update another user's blog.
    

### Expected Result

403 Forbidden

Response:

{  
"message": "You are not authorized to update this blog."  
}

Tests authorization by attempting to update another user's blog using a normal user account.

}

- A normal user must not be allowed to update another user's blog.
    

### Expected Result

## Blog Delete Own

Deletes a blog owned by the authenticated user.

### Method

DELETE

### Endpoint

/api/blogs/delete/:id

### Access

Authenticated User/Admin

### Requirements

- Authentication is required.
    
- The blog must exist.
    
- A normal user can delete only their own blog.
    
- Admin users can delete any user's blog.
    

### Success

200 OK

Response:

{  
"message": "Blog deleted successfully."  
}

### Errors

401 Unauthorized - Authentication token is missing or invalid.  
403 Forbidden - User is not the owner of the blog.  
404 Not Found - Blog does not exist.  
500 Internal Server Error - Server or database error.

### Endpoint

/api/blogs/delete/:id

### Access

Admin

### Requirements

- Authentication is required.
    
- The logged-in user must have the admin role.
    
- The requested blog must exist.
    
- Admin can delete another user's blog.
